_comment: Utility infrastructure layer sources. Set 'enabled': true and provide 'url' for each layer you want to query. Transmission lines are pre-configured with the HIFLD/EIA public ArcGIS Feature Service.

layers.name: Electric Transmission Lines
layers.notes: Public HIFLD dataset. No API key required. Updates annually.

layers.name: Natural Gas Pipelines
layers.note: Add ArcGIS REST URL for natural gas pipeline data. HIFLD interstate/intrastate pipelines are available at: https://services1.arcgis.com/Hp6G80Pky0om7QvQ/arcgis/rest/services/Natural_Gas_Interstate_and_Intrastate_Pipelines/FeatureServer/0/query

layers.name: Water Mains
layers.note: Add municipal or county water authority GIS endpoint. Many utilities publish ArcGIS REST or WFS services — contact the local water authority for access.

layers.name: Sanitary Sewer
layers.note: Add municipal or county sanitary sewer authority GIS endpoint. Storm and sanitary sewer layers may be published separately.

layers.name: Telecommunications
layers.note: Add FCC broadband deployment data or telecom provider GIS endpoint. FCC National Broadband Map: https://broadbandmap.fcc.gov/. Provider-specific underground conduit data requires direct request to the carrier.
